title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Create CDM reference

Load relevant packages



library(omopgenerics)
library(omock)
library(CodelistGenerator)
library(CohortConstructor)
library(CohortCharacteristics)
library(PhenotypeR)
library(here)
library(duckdb)
library(visOmopResults)
library(gt)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)


Create a cdm reference to a synthetic omop database




cdm <- omock::mockCdmFromDataset("delphi-100k",
                                 source = "duckdb")

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Amoxicillin
We can use getDrugIngredientCodes() to find an ingredient and all its descendants

amoxicillin <- getDrugIngredientCodes(cdm = cdm,
                       name = c("amoxicillin"), 
                       nameStyle = "{concept_name}")
amoxicillin


- amoxicillin (13407 codes)



We can use asCodelistWithDetails() to add concept names etc

amoxicillin |> 
  asCodelistWithDetails(cdm) |>
  pluck("amoxicillin") |> 
  glimpse()

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Amoxicillin oral route
Rather than including all amoxicillin concepts, we might want to restrict to only those of a certain route

amoxicillin_oral <- getDrugIngredientCodes(cdm = cdm,
                        name = c("amoxicillin"), 
                        nameStyle = "{concept_name}", 
                        routeCategory = "oral") |> 
  setNames("amoxicillin_oral")
amoxicillin_oral


- amoxicillin_oral (12067 codes)


We can also use subsetOnRouteCategory() for this

amoxicillin |> 
  subsetOnRouteCategory(cdm, routeCategory = "oral")


- amoxicillin (12067 codes)

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Excluding routes
Note, sometimes we might want to exclude a certain route but keep unknown routes etc.

amoxicillin |> 
  subsetOnRouteCategory(cdm, routeCategory = "injectable", negate = TRUE)


- amoxicillin (12176 codes)

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Stratifying by route
Rather than subsetting, we might instead want to stratify by route.

amoxicillin |> 
  stratifyByRouteCategory(cdm)


- amoxicillin_injectable (1231 codes)
- amoxicillin_oral (12067 codes)
- amoxicillin_unclassified_route_category (109 codes)



We can also keep our overall category

amoxicillin |> 
  stratifyByRouteCategory(cdm, keepOriginal = TRUE)


- amoxicillin (13407 codes)
- amoxicillin_injectable (1231 codes)
- amoxicillin_oral (12067 codes)
- amoxicillin_unclassified_route_category (109 codes)

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Other stratifications
By dose form:

amoxicillin |> 
  stratifyByDoseForm(cdm)


- amoxicillin_chewable_tablet (77 codes)
- amoxicillin_delayed_release_oral_capsule (5 codes)
- amoxicillin_delayed_release_oral_tablet (169 codes)
- amoxicillin_disintegrating_oral_tablet (391 codes)
- amoxicillin_effervescent_oral_tablet (24 codes)
- amoxicillin_extended_release_oral_capsule (10 codes)
along with 16 more codelists



By dose unit:

amoxicillin |> 
  stratifyByDoseUnit(cdm)


- amoxicillin_milligram (13331 codes)
- amoxicillin_unclassified_dose_unit (76 codes)
- amoxicillin_unit (6 codes)

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Amoxicillin + clavulanate oral route
First get the codes for each (two independent codelists)

amoxicillin_clavulanate_oral <- getDrugIngredientCodes(cdm, 
                       c("amoxicillin", "clavulanate"), 
                       routeCategory = "oral")
amoxicillin_clavulanate_oral


- 48203_clavulanate (5484 codes)
- 723_amoxicillin (12067 codes)



We can then keep only the codes that appear in both

amoxicillin_clavulanate_oral <- amoxicillin_clavulanate_oral |> 
  intersectCodelists() |> 
  setNames("amoxicillin_with_clavulanate")
amoxicillin_clavulanate_oral


- amoxicillin_with_clavulanate (5248 codes)

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Bind codelists
We can combine them into a single object using bind

amoxicillin_codes <- bind(amoxicillin, 
                          amoxicillin_oral, 
                          amoxicillin_clavulanate_oral)
amoxicillin_codes


- amoxicillin (13407 codes)
- amoxicillin_oral (12067 codes)
- amoxicillin_with_clavulanate (5248 codes)

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Amoxicillin cohorts
→ Create the base cohorts
We first create a base cohort from drug exposure records corresponding to our codelists

cdm$amoxicillin <- conceptCohort(
  cdm = cdm,
  conceptSet = amoxicillin_codes,
  name = "amoxicillin"
)

→ Create treatment episodes and identify new users
We now combine exposures into treatment episodes and apply our new-user criteria:

cdm$amoxicillin_new_users <- cdm$amoxicillin |>
  # Collapse exposures separated by ≤7 days
  collapseCohorts(
    gap = 7,
    name = "amoxicillin_new_users"
  ) |>
 # First ever exposure
 requireIsFirstEntry(name = "amoxicillin_new_users") |> 
 # Adults
  requireAge(ageRange = c(18, 150),
    name = "amoxicillin_new_users"
  )

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Run PhenotypeR diagnostics
phenotypeDiagnostics() allows us to run all the phenotyper diagnostics checks. Drug diagnostics is not run by default, so we will likely want to switch this on

result <- phenotypeDiagnostics(
  cdm$amoxicillin_new_users,
  databaseDiagnostics = list(),
  codelistDiagnostics = list(drugDiagnostics = TRUE),
  cohortDiagnostics = list(),
  populationDiagnostics = list()
)

We can then use shinyDiagnostics to create a shiny app to review our results

shinyDiagnostics(results, here::here())

title: Building drug cohorts in R
text:
Your turn

Create a cohort of new users of injectable heparin, excluding any combinations. Collapse gaps less or equal to 2 days. Require at least 365 days between treatment. Require to be adults (≥ 18 years).
Summarise cohort code use in a table
Summarise cohort attrition in a table
Run phenotyper and create a shiny app with the results
